pairs.target: luó dí de tángxiōng bǎ ròu cáng zài guōdǐ .
pairs.english: Luodi's cousin had hidden the meat at the bottom of the pot.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻的堂兄把肉藏在锅底。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dào shí , zhuōshàng zhǐyǒu yìpán dòu , luó dí zuòzài ménbiān , xiàng zǎojiù děng zhe tā kànjiàn , kuàizi yì shēn , xiān tì tā jiá le mǎn wǎn .
pairs.english: When Tavi arrived, only beans sat on the table. Luodi waited by the door as though anticipating his reaction, reaching with his chopsticks to fill Tavi's bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维到时，桌上只有一盘豆，罗荻坐在门边，像早就等着他看见，筷子一伸，先替他夹了满碗。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèng xiǎng shuō zìjǐ yòu méi wǎn , zào biān nǚrén yǐ ná sháozǐ qiāo le qiāo guō yán , jiào tāmen biénào , ròu hái méi mèn tòu , shuí xiān dòng jiù chī yìng de .
pairs.english: Tavi was about to protest he was not late when the woman at the stove tapped the pot with her spoon: stop fooling, the meat was not tender yet, and anyone taking it now would eat it tough.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维正想说自己又没晚，灶边女人已拿勺子敲了敲锅沿，叫他们别闹，肉还没焖透，谁先动就吃硬的。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ tānzhe xīn dào de cǎo dài .
pairs.english: Newly arrived grass bands were spread in the yard.
pairs.hanzi: 院里摊着新到的草带。

pairs.target: nàge zài xiējiǎo péng jiàn guò de ǎipàng nánrén yě lái le , zuòzài zhúdèng shàng , kùjiǎo juàn dào xī biān ; dài báitáo pái de nǚrén dūn zài pángbiān , zhèng jiāng yìtiáo bèi chóng yǎo guò de tiāochūlái .
pairs.english: The stout man from the rest shelter had come too, sitting on a bamboo stool with his trousers rolled to his knees. The woman with the white ceramic tally crouched beside him, picking out an insect-chewed band.
pairs.hanzi: 那个在歇脚棚见过的矮胖男人也来了，坐在竹凳上，裤脚卷到膝边；带白陶牌的女人蹲在旁边，正将一条被虫咬过的挑出来。

pairs.target: tángxiōng zuǐlǐ shuō zhèdiǎn bùfáng shì , shǒu què gēnzhe tā zhǐ de wèizhì mō le yíbiàn , zuìhòu lìng fàng le yìxiǎo kǔn .
pairs.english: The cousin said it did not matter, yet felt the spot she indicated and finally set a small bundle aside.
pairs.hanzi: 堂兄嘴里说这点不妨事，手却跟着她指的位置摸了一遍，最后另放了一小捆。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ dàilái de liǎngkuài tiánbǐng gēxià , nǚrén táitóu rènchū tā , wèn qīngguǒ hòulái yànxiàqù le méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi put down the two sweet cakes he had brought. Recognizing him, the woman looked up and asked whether he had managed to swallow the green fruit.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把带来的两块甜饼搁下，女人抬头认出他，问青果后来咽下去了没有。

pairs.target: luó dí lìjí kàn xiàng tángxiōng , tángxiōng shuō zìjǐ kě méi chuán , pō shàng nà yìshēng hǎn , bàngè péng de rén dōu tīngjiàn le .
pairs.english: Luodi immediately looked at his cousin, who said he had spread nothing: half the shelter had heard that shout on the slope.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻立即看向堂兄，堂兄说自己可没传，坡上那一声喊，半个棚的人都听见了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi juéde liǎn rè , suǒxìng wèn tāmen dàihuí de cǎo wèishénme bù biānchéng xí , shěngde zhèyàng yìgēn gēn tiāo .
pairs.english: Tavi felt his face warm and asked why the grass was not woven into mats, saving all this picking through individual bands.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维觉得脸热，索性问他们带回的草为什么不编成席，省得这样一根根挑。

pairs.target: ǎipàng nánrén ná qǐ yìtiáo , zài shǒuzhǐ shàng rào le liǎngquān , yòu sōngkāi , cǎo dài tán chū yìdiǎn wān , xiàng hái jìde xiānqián de xíngzhuàng .
pairs.english: The stout man wound one twice around his finger and released it. The band sprang into a slight curve, as though remembering its earlier shape.
pairs.hanzi: 矮胖男人拿起一条，在手指上绕了两圈，又松开，草带弹出一点弯，像还记得先前的形状。

pairs.target: tā shuō zhěngpiàn biān sǐ , línguò shuǐ búyì chāi liàng , lùshang rén yònglái kǔn kě jiē de dǐng piàn , huài yìbiān huàn yìbiān , búbì bǎ zhěngjiān péng xiān le .
pairs.english: He said a tightly woven sheet was hard to dismantle and dry after rain. Travelers tied removable roof panels with it, replacing one damaged side without stripping the whole shelter.
pairs.hanzi: 他说整片编死，淋过水不易拆晾，路上人用来捆可揭的顶片，坏一边换一边，不必把整间棚掀了。

pairs.target: tángxiōng yào de què búshì gài péng . tā jiāng chēzuò biān yíkuài jiù pídiàn fān qǐ , gěi nánrén kàn lǐmiàn mósuì de chèn céng , shuō shìbiān yìxiǎopiàn , zuò zhe bù chuō rén , cái kěn zài shōu .
pairs.english: But the cousin wanted it for something else. Lifting an old leather seat pad, he showed the man its crumbled lining: he would try weaving a small patch, buying more only if it did not prick the sitter.
pairs.hanzi: 堂兄要的却不是盖棚。他将车座边一块旧皮垫翻起，给男人看里面磨碎的衬层，说试编一小片，坐着不戳人，才肯再收。

pairs.target: jiàqián yǐjīng tán guò , shèngxià zhè yíbù shuí yě tì bùliǎo tā , luó dí biàn yòng dùn tóu zhēn chuān dàizǐ , chuān cuò yì gé , ràng tángxiōng pāi huíqù chóng lái .
pairs.english: The price was agreed, but nobody could do this last part for him. Luodi threaded bands with a blunt needle, missed a square, and was swatted back by his cousin to start again.
pairs.hanzi: 价钱已经谈过，剩下这一步谁也替不了他，罗荻便用钝头针穿带子，穿错一格，让堂兄拍回去重来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xǐshǒu huílái , kànjiàn guō kāi le , ròu xiāng zhèng cóng rèqì lǐ wǎng wài zuàn . zào biān nǚrén tì měirén yǎo yìsháo , wèn luó dí míngzǎo qùbuqù kàn xīn pùmiàn .
pairs.english: Returning from washing, Tavi found the pot boiling and the smell of meat escaping in steam. The woman served each a spoonful and asked whether Luodi would inspect the new shop tomorrow morning.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维洗手回来，看见锅开了，肉香正从热气里往外钻。灶边女人替每人舀一勺，问罗荻明早去不去看新铺面。

pairs.target: luó dí hán zhe ròu , xiān diǎntóu , yòu yáotóu , shuō yào děng shàngwǔ nà liàng xiū guò de chē lái shì zhóu .
pairs.english: With meat in his mouth, Luodi nodded, then shook his head: he must wait for a repaired cart's axle test in the morning.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻含着肉，先点头，又摇头，说要等上午那辆修过的车来试轴。

pairs.target: tángxiōng xiǎng zū hébiān yìjiān wū , qiántou néng bǎi liǎngjià chē , hòutou què zhī gòu fàng mùliào .
pairs.english: His cousin wanted a riverside room: two carts would fit in front, but only timber at the back.
pairs.hanzi: 堂兄想租河边一间屋，前头能摆两架车，后头却只够放木料。

pairs.target: nǚrén shuō bān guòqù jiù dé lìng zhǎo zhǔfàn de dìfāng , bùnéng quán píng tā ná gēn gān liáng guò biàn dāying .
pairs.english: The woman said moving meant finding another cooking space; he could not agree just because he had measured it with a pole.
pairs.hanzi: 女人说搬过去就得另找煮饭的地方，不能全凭他拿根杆量过便答应。

pairs.target: tángxiōng shuō méi dāying , wǎn yì gē , wèn luó dí shìbushì yǐjīng gàosù fángdōng kěn zū .
pairs.english: The cousin said he had not agreed, put his bowl down, and asked if Luodi had already told the landlord yes.
pairs.hanzi: 堂兄说没答应，碗一搁，问罗荻是不是已经告诉房东肯租。

pairs.target: luó dí jiào le qǐlái , shuō zìjǐ zhī tì tā wèn xiàgèyuè kōng bu kōng .
pairs.english: Luodi cried out that he had only asked for him whether it was vacant next month.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻叫了起来，说自己只替他问下个月空不空。

pairs.target: mǎnzhuō rén xiào , tǎ wéi yě gēnzhe xiào , zhídào nǚrén wèn hé lù suǒ de xuéshēng zhù hébiān hǎobuhǎo , tā cái fāxiàn zhè búshì suíkǒu xiánliáo , tā zhēn zài děng zìjǐ de yìsī .
pairs.english: Everyone laughed and Tavi joined in, until the woman asked the Joint Routes student whether riverside living was good. He realized it was no idle chat; she truly awaited his opinion.
pairs.hanzi: 满桌人笑，塔维也跟着笑，直到女人问合路所的学生住河边好不好，他才发现这不是随口闲聊，她真在等自己的意思。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng le xiǎng , zhī shuō zìjǐ zhù de kèzhàn yǔtiān lǐngkǒu dōu gān bú tòu , ruò nà wū yě bèiyīn , zuìhǎo jìnqù kànkàn .
pairs.english: He thought, then only said his inn's collars never dried in rain; if that room was shaded too, they should look inside.
pairs.hanzi: 他想了想，只说自己住的客栈雨天领口都干不透，若那屋也背阴，最好进去看看。

pairs.target: tángxiōng yǒuxiē shīwàng , shuō wèn tā shì yīn tā shàng guò xuégōng , hái yǐwéi néng kànchū gèng duō .
pairs.english: The cousin was a little disappointed: he had asked because Tavi attended the academy and might see more.
pairs.hanzi: 堂兄有些失望，说问他是因他上过学宫，还以为能看出更多。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yìshí méi jiē huà , bái pái nǚrén jiāng ròu lǐ de gǔtou tiāo dào wǎn biān , shuō zìjǐ zǒuguò nàme duōlù , yě méi tì shuí kànchū guò wūlǐ nǎ chù hǎo zhǔfàn , ràng tā míngrì dài zhe guō qù , bǎi bù kāi jiù bié zū .
pairs.english: Tavi fell silent. Picking bones to her bowl's edge, the tally woman said all her travels had never told her where to cook in someone else's house. He should take the pot tomorrow; if it would not fit, don't rent.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维一时没接话，白牌女人将肉里的骨头挑到碗边，说自己走过那么多路，也没替谁看出过屋里哪处好煮饭，让他明日带着锅去，摆不开就别租。

pairs.target: nǚrén ná sháozǐ xiàomà , jiào tāmen bié zhēn bǎ guō bānzǒu . huàtóu yòu zhuǎnhuí wūyán hé fángzū , tǎ wéi chèn méi rén kàn zìjǐ , duō jiá le yíkuài ròu .
pairs.english: Holding her spoon, the cook laughed and scolded them not to actually carry her pot away. Talk returned to eaves and rent, and Tavi took another piece of meat while nobody watched.
pairs.hanzi: 女人拿勺子笑骂，叫他们别真把锅搬走。话头又转回屋檐和房租，塔维趁没人看自己，多夹了一块肉。

pairs.target: luó dí lìkè ná kuàizi qiāo tā de wǎn biān , shuō tā fāngcái chī de shì shuí wǎn lǐ de dòu , xiànzài kě bùnéng wàng .
pairs.english: Luodi immediately tapped his bowl with chopsticks: he must not forget whose beans he had just eaten.
pairs.hanzi: 罗荻立刻拿筷子敲他的碗边，说他方才吃的是谁碗里的豆，现在可不能忘。

pairs.target: chī dào bàntú , tǎ wéi zhōngyú wèn nàtiáo xī wā zhuǎn xiàn . tā xiān shuō shìcóng jiù xiū bó chāo de míng , búshì yǎnqián tāmen huà de shí wā xiǎolù , wèn nǚrén tīng guò méiyǒu .
pairs.english: Halfway through the meal, Tavi finally asked about the West Hollow transfer route. He explained it was copied from an old repair book, not their stone-hollow path, and asked if the woman had heard of it.
pairs.hanzi: 吃到半途，塔维终于问那条西洼转线。他先说是从旧修簿抄的名，不是眼前他们画的石洼小路，问女人听过没有。

pairs.target: tā jiào tā xiě chūlái , kàn le yíhuìer , yáotóu , shuō zìjǐ rènde de lùshang méiyǒu zhème jiào de .
pairs.english: She had him write it down, looked a while, then shook her head: none of the routes she knew were called that.
pairs.hanzi: 她叫他写出来，看了一会儿，摇头，说自己认得的路上没有这么叫的。

pairs.target: ǎipàng nánrén quèshuō , zài xībiān jiàn guò yìxiē jiù shítái , kěnéng shì nàtiáo xiàn liúxià de . nǚrén jiāng wǎn fàngxià , wèn tā nǎ yíchù .
pairs.english: The stout man said he had seen old stone platforms to the west, perhaps remains of that route. The woman put her bowl down and asked where.
pairs.hanzi: 矮胖男人却说，在西边见过一些旧石台，可能是那条线留下的。女人将碗放下，问他哪一处。

pairs.target: nánrén bǐ zhe shuō le liǎnghuí , cái xiǎngqǐ nà shì tóngháng de rén jiǎng de , zìjǐ méiyǒu qùguò .
pairs.english: After gesturing twice, the man remembered a companion had told him; he had not been there himself.
pairs.hanzi: 男人比着说了两回，才想起那是同行的人讲的，自己没有去过。

pairs.target: tā méi zài wǎng xià cāi , jiào tǎ wéi ruòzhēn yào jì , jiù bǎ zhè céng yě jì shàng , bié guò jǐtiān biàn xiěchéng tāmen qīnyǎnkànjiàn .
pairs.english: She stopped guessing and told Tavi to record that distinction too, rather than turn it into their eyewitness account days later.
pairs.hanzi: 她没再往下猜，叫塔维若真要记，就把这层也记上，别过几天便写成他们亲眼看见。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zhǐ liúzài yìbiān , méiyǒu jí zhe wèn dìèrgè míng .
pairs.english: Tavi laid the paper aside and did not rush to ask a second name.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将纸留在一边，没有急着问第二个名。

pairs.target: tā yuánxiān pàn nà jǐgè zì néng ràng rén zhǐ yígè fāngxiàng , yǎnxià zhuōshàng rénrén dōu zuò dé hěn jìn , nà yìtóu què réng yuǎn .
pairs.english: He had hoped those words would give a direction. Everyone sat close around the table, but the far end remained distant.
pairs.hanzi: 他原先盼那几个字能让人指一个方向，眼下桌上人人都坐得很近，那一头却仍远。

pairs.target: tā kànzhe nǚrén wàn biān de bái pái , hūrán wèn , dìyīcì chū shúlù de shíhòu , tā pàbupà .
pairs.english: Looking at the white tally by her wrist, he suddenly asked if she had been afraid the first time she left familiar routes.
pairs.hanzi: 他看着女人腕边的白牌，忽然问，第一次出熟路的时候，她怕不怕。

pairs.target: " pà . " tā shuō , " yóuqí pà gēn cuò le huì zhǔfàn de rén . "
pairs.english: “Yes,” she said. “Especially of following the wrong cook.”
pairs.hanzi: “怕。”她说，“尤其怕跟错了会煮饭的人。”

pairs.target: ǎipàng nánrén lìkè shuō zìjǐ nà guō méi jiāo , shì xiàmiàn běnlái jiù gāi jié ké .
pairs.english: The stout man instantly said his pot had not burned; it was meant to form a crust underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 矮胖男人立刻说自己那锅没焦，是下面本来就该结壳。

pairs.target: tángxiōng xiào dé wǎnghòuyǎng , lián luó dí dōu méi tì tā jiē huà .
pairs.english: The cousin leaned back laughing; even Luodi offered no defense.
pairs.hanzi: 堂兄笑得往后仰，连罗荻都没替他接话。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe jiāng zhǐ shōuhuí yī nèi , xīnlǐ nà diǎn luòkōng bìng méi quánsàn , què yǐjīng bù fángài tā zài jiē yìwǎn rètāng .
pairs.english: Smiling, Tavi tucked the paper into his clothes. His disappointment had not entirely faded, but it no longer stopped him accepting another bowl of hot soup.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑着将纸收回衣内，心里那点落空并没全散，却已经不妨碍他再接一碗热汤。
